text_block_list.text: Hmm... What an unruly machine, indeed.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Please do not blame yourself for these
results. I
believe luck was simply not on
your side this time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Let me try one more time!

text_block_list.text:
Don't do it. Giving in to the impulse to
try "one
more time" will lead you quickly
toward the sunk
cost fallacy and ruin our
plans.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However, I am grateful you are so
motivated to
win a plushie for me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
